name: Drift correction benchmark for high-density extracellular recordings
description: A modular implementation and benchmarking framework that evaluates drift-correction methods on high-density extracellular electrophysiological recordings to quantify spike-sorting stability and accuracy.
general_score_metric: sorting_accuracy (unit detection accuracy combined with false-positive rate and stability metrics)
reputation: Well-regarded in the electrophysiology/neuroscience community as a practical, modular framework for benchmarking drift-correction methods on high-density recordings, though adoption is mainly among labs working on spike sorting.
notes: Relies on ground-truth or simulated drift scenarios; results can be sensitive to simulation parameters and recording conditions. Not an LLM benchmark and may not generalize across all probe types or brain regions.
